Conservative scope exclusion: unlettered drawing study rather than an identifiable bookplate or ownership emblem.

Unknown original date and artist; source is a 1987 reprint. Cached PD-old claim does not establish original work age or creator term.
Modern institutional seal used as ownership stamp; underlying designer/date and public-domain basis are not established.
Artist field names Chris Lebeau, while description says designed by Chris Moret; conflicting creator attribution remains unresolved.
Title-page/portrait spread with incidental handwritten inscription; not a dominant printed bookplate or ownership mark.
Handwritten ex-libris inscription rather than a printed bookplate or printed ownership mark.
Publisher device without book-ownership wording; conservative scope rejection.

Cover and school crest rather than a clear ownership bookplate; conservative scope rejection.
